description: This file defines a class 'BuzzPostDecorator' which is part of the OrangeHRM system. It serves as a decorator for 'BuzzPost' entities, providing methods to set an employee by their employee number and managing the associated 'BuzzPost' object. It also uses traits for ORM assistance.

classes.name: BuzzPostDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for BuzzPost entity, facilitating setting employee information using employee number and ORM helper methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the BuzzPostDecorator with a BuzzPost entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee for the BuzzPost based on the employee number by retrieving the Employee reference.
